ei.title: 도시 교통 정책에서 드러나는 지속 가능성의 역설과 모순

fullPassage: The paradox of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport. Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment. All too often in policy documents where environmental sustainability is discussed the urgent necessity of social and economic change is glossed over in language designed to reassure the reader that the right trade-off can be found between economic, social and environmental policies. With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds. Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'. Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth (for that is what has always been done), it is logically impossible to trade off environmentally unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability. Growth is either environmentally sustainable or it's not.

questions.passage: The paradox of sustainability (A)[emerges / vanishes] strongly in urban transport. Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that (B)[deplete / restore] and ruin the environment. All too often in policy documents where environmental sustainability is discussed the urgent necessity of social and economic change is glossed over in language designed to reassure the reader that the right trade-off can be found between economic, social and environmental policies. With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds. Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'. Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth (for that is what has always been done), it is logically impossible to trade off environmentally (C)[unsustainable / renewable] growth against environmental sustainability. Growth is either environmentally sustainable or it's not.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ② emerges — deplete — unsustainable: 역설이 '나타나고', 환경을 '고갈'시키며, '지속 불가능한' 성장.
❌ ① vanishes — deplete — unsustainable: '사라진다'는 역설 맥락과 반대.
❌ ③ emerges — restore — unsustainable: '복원하다'는 ruin과 병렬 불가.
❌ ④ emerges — deplete — renewable: '재생 가능한'은 원문 unsustainable과 반대.

Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment. With this magic mixture all will indeed be for the best in this world, the best of all possible worlds. Such policies deserve the term 'greenwash'. Whereas it is possible to trade off environmental and health benefits against economic growth (for that is what has always been done), it is logically (C)[impossible / inevitable] to trade off environmentally unsustainable growth against environmental sustainability. det.analysis:
✅ ① necessity — reassure — impossible: 변화의 '필요성'이 간과되고, 독자를 '안심'시키며, 논리적으로 '불가능'한 교환.
❌ ② impossibility — reassure — impossible: '불가능성'은 변화의 긴급함과 맞지 않음.
❌ ③ necessity — alarm — impossible: '경보를 울리다'는 reassure의 반대.
❌ ④ necessity — reassure — inevitable: '불가피한'은 원문과 반대 논리.

questions.passage: The (A)[paradox / solution] of sustainability emerges strongly in urban transport. Governments that espouse environmental sustainability also espouse transport policies that deplete and ruin the environment. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① paradox — deserve — economic: 지속 가능성의 '역설', '그린워시'라는 용어를 '받을 만하다', '경제적' 성장.
❌ ② solution — deserve — economic: '해결책'은 역설과 반대.
❌ ③ paradox — reject — economic: '거부하다'는 의미 반대.
❌ ④ paradox — deserve — ecological: '생태적' 성장은 원문 economic과 다름.
det.tip: paradox(역설). deserve(~할 만하다). economic growth(경제 성장).

det.tip: trade — 동사: 교환하다, 거래하다 / 명사: 무역, 직업.

det.analysis:

❌ ① (A) 경고하다 — (B) 안심시키다: (A)는 경고가 아님.
❌ ③ (A) 안심시키다 — (B) 경고하다: (B)는 경고가 아님.

det.tip: reassure — 안심시키다, 다시 확신을 주다. 맥락에 따라 진정한/허위 안심.
